summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K reporting it will early redeem and cancel two self-held export finance covered bond series on 19 October 2026 (settlement cited as 17 October): EUR 1.2bn Series 2 October 2027 (12,000 bonds at EUR 100,000) and USD 3.8bn Series 3 October 2027 (19,000 bonds at USD 200,000). All bonds are held by the issuer, so this is an intra-group liability cleanup on the coupon date, not a market-facing capital return or tender. No advisor, premium, or board recommendation applies; watch only for funding and regulatory capital optics.
